title: Teucer
summary: Raleigh names Teucer in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Teucer, who first gaue name to the Countrie wherein Troy was afterwards built by Dardanus. He is not Teucer the sonne of Telamon. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIV, §. I, sig. 277a
